### Dear Sir, I Am
Author: Joe Holland
Site: Reformed Bible Studies & Devotionals at Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/dear-sir-i-am
Passage: Psalm 10:7
Points:
- Psalm 10 vividly depicts the wicked person whose mouth overflows with deception, cursing, and malice.
- Readers frequently direct the warnings of imprecatory psalms outward against external enemies.
- Paul quotes Psalm 10:7 in Romans 3 to diagnose the universal sinfulness of the human heart.
- Scripture compels believers to humbly recognize that they share this same depravity apart from grace.
- Jesus endured the full curse and judgment of God on the cross to redeem sinners.

### Devotional: Psalm 10
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/leviticus-9-psalm-10-proverbs-24-1-thess-3/
Passage: Psalm 10:1-18
Points:
- The psalmist wrestles with God's apparent distance while corrupt and arrogant people prosper.
- The wicked operate with practical atheism, assuming God never notices their cruelty toward the helpless.
- The sufferer boldly calls on the Lord to rise up and remember the afflicted.
- God does see hidden grief and oppression, serving as the helper and defender of the fatherless.
- True confidence rests in God's eternal kingship and the inevitable arrival of divine justice.
